parsed.notes:
Read “Additional experience we value” literally as an unmarked qualifications heading, not an explicitly optional heading; affected skills without another required mention are flagged for review.
The later “highly desirable” sentence makes AutoGen optional; it does not override earlier required mentions of LangGraph, CrewAI, or LLM orchestration.
Alternative grouping needs review: the orchestration examples overlap across two differently qualified lists, and the heterogeneous tool examples recur under separate technical categories; no groups are asserted here.
The data-science library lists use inclusive wording and are not treated as alternatives.
Seniority follows the guide’s explicit “proven experience” inference to mid; the 2+ years minimum alone does not establish seniority beyond that.
GPT, Claude, and Llama are model names here, not requests for OpenAI API, Anthropic API, or open-source LLM experience.
Company-description technologies and technologies mentioned only in responsibilities are excluded.
